text: Illustrate the story here: Yams! Yum! A yak looks at a plant. It's a yam plant. The yak digs to get a yam from the plant. The yak stomps on the yam to cut it into bits. A dog sees the plant. The dog digs to get a yam from the plant. The dog can not stomp on the yam. The yak helps the dog. "Yum," said the yak, "yams are the best!" "Yes," said the dog, "yum, yum, yum!"
